items.q: When he entered my house, I got the letter from the President inviting me.

ctx.x: No, I never got any. When he entered my house, I got the letter from the President inviting me. I think it's on there, I'm not sure. I know I had it there.
Yes, he had the invitations. It was a most remarkable affair. You were there, along with all the dignitaries, not people --
